name: Thrill Berserker

features.Infectious Thrill: When an enemy rolls a Complication Complication on an attack test against the berserker, the enemy gains a +3 bonus to that d20 roll. Regardless of whether the attack hits or misses, if any other characters are within 5 feet of the berserker, the enemy must choose one. The enemy’s attack also grazes the chosen character (without spending focus).

Strike Longsword.Description: Attack +4, reach 5 ft., one target. Graze: 4 (1d8) keen damage. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) keen damage, and if the target is Prone, they take an extra 4 (1d8) damage.

Strike Dagger.Description: Attack +3, range 20/60 ft., one target. Graze: 2 (1d4) keen damage. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) keen damage.

Shield Bash.Description: The berserker makes an Athletics test against the Physical defense of a Large or smaller character within 5 feet of them, knocking them Prone on a success.

Berserker Rage.Description: The Thrill surges within the berserker. Their next Strike targets each character within 5 feet of them and deals an extra 3 (1d6) damage on a hit.

Lash Out.Description: After the berserker is attacked by an enemy within 5 feet of them, the berserker deals 4 (1d8) keen damage to the attacker

Tactics: A Thrill berserker rushes into battle, undeterred by formidable enemies and careful fortifications. They fight with alarming ferocity, using Berserker Rage and Shield Bash to cleave their path, regardless of whether friend or foe stands in the way.
